texts.Feature:VaultIndex.Enable:Description: Lets the tenant use Vault Index's application services: search and index management.
texts.VaultIndex:EmptyDocument: The document has no text to index.
texts.VaultIndex:DocumentTooLarge: The document's text has {Length} characters, more than the {MaxLength} the index accepts.
texts.VaultIndex:TooManyChunks: The document splits into {Count} chunks, more than the {Max} the index accepts.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingGeneratorMissing: No embedding model is configured for Vault Index.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingModelChanged: Search needs the embedding model {ServingModelId}, which built the serving index, and this host does not have it: it is configured with {ModelId}. Search resumes once the index being rebuilt for {ModelId} takes over, or once {ServingModelId} is registered as the previous embedding model.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingDimensionMismatch: The embedding model returned {Dimensions}-dimension vectors; the index storage holds {StorageDimensions}.
texts.VaultIndex:UnsupportedReadScope: Extract returned a read scope of version {Version}, which this version of Vault Index does not support.
texts.VaultIndex:InvalidPointer: '{Pointer}' is not a pointer returned by search or outline.
texts.IndexStatus:ExactSearchLimitExceeded: Over {0} chunks: vector search is exact and slows down past this size.
texts.IndexStatus:NoModelConfigured: No embedding model is configured, so nothing is indexed.
texts.IndexStatus:ModelMismatch: The configured model is not the one the index was built with. The index is rebuilt for it, starting with the next document indexed or the next --migrate-database.
texts.IndexStatus:ServingModelUnavailable: Search is refused: this host does not have {0}, the model the serving index was built with. It resumes when the rebuilt index takes over, or once {0} is configured as the previous model.
texts.IndexStatus:BuildingFailed: {0} documents could not be embedded with the new model; their runs say why. The rebuilt index takes over only once every document is in it.
texts.IndexStatus:KeywordIndexUnavailable: Full-Text Search is not installed: search uses vectors only.
texts.IndexStatus:Title: Title
texts.IndexStatus:RebuildConfirm: Index this document again from its current text, even if nothing changed?
texts.VaultIndex:FieldFilterTooBroad: The field conditions match more than {Max} documents. Add a condition to narrow them.
texts.VaultIndex:ChatModelUnavailable: No chat model is configured for Vault Index (Vault:Index:ChatModelId), so summaries cannot be compiled.
texts.VaultIndex:SummariesOff: This document's type does not compile summaries. Switch them on in its index profile first.
texts.IndexStatus:RecompileConfirm: Compile this document's summaries again from its chunks, even if they are current? This calls the model.
texts.SearchTest:InvalidSetting: A setting is not a number.
texts.SearchTest:Hint: Runs the query as search does, within your read scope. The settings apply to this run only; empty ones take the host's values.
texts.SearchTest:Timings: Keyword {0} ms, vector {1} ms, rerank {2} ms
texts.Chunks:Hint: A disabled chunk is left out of search, outline and read, and stays disabled after a rebuild while its text is unchanged. To correct the text, correct the document's Markdown in Extract.
texts.Chunks:Disabled: The chunk is out of retrieval.
texts.Chunks:Enabled: The chunk is back in retrieval.
texts.Profiles:Hint: How each document type is cut into chunks. A type without its own profile uses the layer default. A change re-chunks and re-embeds the affected documents in the background.
texts.Profiles:ResetConfirm: Use the layer default for this type?
texts.Profiles:Saved: Saved. The affected documents are rebuilt in the background.
texts.Profiles:StrategyHint.0: Chunks follow the heading tree and carry their heading path; a table stays whole with the text around it, and a large one is split by rows repeating its header. For contracts, rules, manuals, invoices and reports.
texts.Profiles:StrategyHint.1: A fixed token count with overlap, for text without headings.
texts.Profiles:InvalidChunkSize: The chunk size must be between {0} and {1} tokens.
texts.Profiles:InvalidOverlap: The overlap must be 0 or more and smaller than the chunk size.
texts.Profiles:EstimateNothing: Saving rebuilds nothing: no indexed document uses other settings.
texts.Profiles:Estimate: Saving rebuilds {0} documents ({1} chunks today). Their last indexing took {2} embedding tokens.
texts.Profiles:EstimateWithUnknown: Saving rebuilds {0} documents ({1} chunks today). Their last indexing took {2} embedding tokens; {3} of them have no recorded count.
texts.Profiles:EnrichmentHint: An LLM adds keywords to each chunk (keyword index) and the questions it answers (keyword index and embedding). About one model call per 10 chunks.
texts.Profiles:ChatModelUnavailable: The host has no Index chat model (Vault:Index:ChatModelId), so enrichment and summaries cannot be switched on.
texts.Profiles:SummariesHint: An LLM writes one sentence for each section of the outline and a short summary of the document, after each sync. The outline (REST and MCP) shows them. A few model calls per document.
texts.Profiles:EstimateSummaries: Summaries are compiled for {0} documents, about {1} model calls.
